newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian shares close mixed in light trade.
newsitem.headline: Russian shares close mixed in light trade.

text.p: Leading Russian shares closed mixed on Monday in light trading, traders said.
The Russian Trading System index of 21 shares fell by 0.07 percent to 181.95 on a volume of $5.82 million.
"The market will stay at current levels for a couple more days, then slip slightly and start rising," said Andrei Ippolitov, corporate securities director at IK Prospekt.
Mosenergo closed at $0.971 on the RTS after $0.970 at Friday's close, and Norilsk Nickel rose to $7.75 from $7.70.
Ippolitov said the long-term support level for Norilsk Nickel was $6.00 and for Mosenergo $0.70.
Samit Yakovlev, a trader from United City Bank, said a fall in some share prices was due to a big inflow of shares from outside Moscow.
"The offer is only coming from the regions," he said. "We do not see any offer from the West at such levels."
He said Western investors showed interest in many shares despite a bank holiday in Britain.
"I was surprised that despite a holiday in London, there were buying orders," he said. "I think the market will rise tomorrow, after the holiday."
St Petersburg Telephone was the advancer of the day, rising 15.41 percent on the RTS to $17.60 from $15.25.
Mikhail Khaleyev, a trader from IK Alfa-Capital, said illiquid shares, especially those of electricity and telecoms companies, were under steady demand from Western investors.
St Petersburg Telephone was firmer than any other share, because individuals had almost stopped selling the shares.
UES rose to $0.0819 from $0.0810, and Rostelekom was $2.57 after $2.56.
